title: Python Developer
context:
Python Developer
Primary Job Responsibilities:
The Python Developer is an entry-level role for recent graduates (0-1 years) who want to build backend services and automation in Python. The candidate will work in a small agile team, pair with senior developers, and ship small, well-tested features from the first month.
Responsibilities:
API Development – Build and maintain REST endpoints using FastAPI or Flask, with request validation and clear error handling.
Database Work – Write SQL queries and simple data models against PostgreSQL, and help with schema changes under guidance.
Testing & Quality – Write unit tests with pytest, fix reported bugs, and follow PEP 8 and team code-review feedback.
Automation – Create small Python scripts for data cleanup, report generation and repetitive internal tasks.
Learning & Collaboration – Use Git branches and pull requests, join daily stand-ups, and document the modules you build.
Job Requirements:
•
B.E./B.Tech/BCA/MCA (or final-year student) in Computer Science, IT or a related field
Solid Python fundamentals: data structures, OOP, file handling, exceptions
Basic understanding of REST APIs and SQL
Working knowledge of Git and GitHub
Academic or personal projects (e.g., an API, a CRUD app, a scraper) are a plus
Good problem-solving skills and willingness to learn

title: Java Developer
context:
Java Developer
Primary Job Responsibilities:
The Java Developer is an entry-level position for fresh graduates who have a strong base in core Java and want to grow into enterprise application development. Mentorship and structured onboarding are provided.
Responsibilities:
Feature Development – Implement small features and bug fixes in Java and Spring Boot applications under senior guidance.
Database Integration – Write JDBC/JPA queries and work with MySQL or PostgreSQL tables used by the application.
Code Quality – Write JUnit test cases, follow coding standards, and address peer code-review comments.
Debugging – Read logs, reproduce issues, and help trace defects to their root cause.
Team Practices – Use Git and Maven, attend sprint ceremonies, and keep task status and documentation updated.
Job Requirements:
•
B.E./B.Tech/BCA/MCA (or final-year student) in Computer Science, IT or a related field
Strong core Java: OOP, collections, exception handling, multithreading basics
Basic knowledge of Spring Boot and REST APIs
Understanding of SQL and relational databases
Good grasp of data structures and algorithms
Internship or project experience in Java is a plus

title: Frontend Developer
context:
Frontend Developer
Primary Job Responsibilities:
The Frontend Developer will join the UI team to learn how production web interfaces are built. This role suits freshers who enjoy turning designs into clean, responsive, accessible pages.
Responsibilities:
UI Development – Convert Figma designs into responsive pages using HTML, CSS and JavaScript/React components.
API Integration – Connect UI components to REST APIs, handle loading and error states, and display data correctly.
Cross-Browser & Device Testing – Check layouts on different screen sizes and browsers and fix visual bugs.
Code Practices – Build reusable components, use Git for version control, and respond to review feedback.
Collaboration – Work with designers and backend developers to clarify requirements and improve usability.
Job Requirements:
•
B.E./B.Tech/BCA/MCA/Diploma (or final-year student) in Computer Science, IT or a related field
Good knowledge of HTML5, CSS3 (Flexbox/Grid) and modern JavaScript (ES6+)
Basic experience with React (components, props, state, hooks)
Familiarity with fetching data from APIs
A small portfolio or GitHub projects showing your UI work is a plus
Attention to detail and eagerness to learn

title: Data Analyst
context:
Data Analyst
Primary Job Responsibilities:
The Data Analyst is an entry-level role for graduates who like working with numbers and turning data into clear insights. The candidate will support the analytics team with reporting, cleaning and visualization tasks.
Responsibilities:
Data Preparation – Collect, clean and validate datasets from spreadsheets and databases using Excel, SQL and Python (pandas).
Reporting – Build and refresh weekly and monthly dashboards in Power BI or Tableau.
Analysis – Run basic analysis such as trends, comparisons and summary statistics, and present findings in simple language.
Data Quality – Flag missing, duplicate or inconsistent records and document the fixes applied.
Stakeholder Support – Answer ad-hoc data requests from business teams with guidance from senior analysts.
Job Requirements:
•
B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc/BCA/MCA (or final-year student) in Computer Science, Statistics, Maths or a related field
Working knowledge of SQL (joins, group by, filters) and Excel
Basic Python with pandas or similar
Understanding of basic statistics
Exposure to Power BI or Tableau through coursework or projects is a plus
Clear communication and curiosity about data

title: Software Test Engineer
context:
Software Test Engineer
Primary Job Responsibilities:
The Software Test Engineer is an entry-level QA role for fresh graduates who want to build a career in software quality. The candidate will learn manual and automated testing on live product releases.
Responsibilities:
Test Design – Read requirements and write clear test cases, including positive, negative and edge-case scenarios.
Test Execution – Run manual and regression tests on web applications and report results accurately.
Defect Tracking – Log bugs in JIRA with steps to reproduce, screenshots and severity, and retest fixes.
API & Automation Basics – Test APIs with Postman and help automate simple test flows using Selenium.
Team Collaboration – Join sprint planning and daily stand-ups, and work closely with developers to clarify issues.
Job Requirements:
•
B.E./B.Tech/BCA/MCA (or final-year student) in Computer Science, IT or a related field
Understanding of SDLC, STLC and common testing types
Basic knowledge of SQL and how web applications work
Familiarity with Postman or Selenium is a plus
Strong attention to detail and logical thinking
Clear written communication for bug reports

title: DevOps Engineer
context:
DevOps Engineer
Primary Job Responsibilities:
The DevOps Engineer is an entry-level role for graduates interested in build automation, deployments and cloud infrastructure. The candidate will support the DevOps team and learn production practices step by step.
Responsibilities:
CI/CD Support – Maintain and troubleshoot build and deployment pipelines in GitHub Actions or Jenkins.
Containers – Write and update Dockerfiles and help run services in containers.
Scripting – Automate routine tasks using Bash or Python scripts.
Monitoring – Watch dashboards and alerts, and escalate issues with clear notes.
Cloud Basics – Assist with setting up and managing basic AWS resources (EC2, S3, IAM) under supervision.
Job Requirements:
•
B.E./B.Tech/BCA/MCA (or final-year student) in Computer Science, IT or a related field
Comfort with Linux command line and Git
Basic understanding of networking, HTTP and CI/CD concepts
Basic scripting in Bash or Python
Cloud certification or hands-on lab experience (AWS/Azure) is a plus
Willingness to learn and take on-call learning shifts later

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
context:
Cybersecurity Analyst
Primary Job Responsibilities:
The Cybersecurity Analyst is an entry-level position for graduates with a foundation in security and networking. The candidate will help the security team monitor systems, triage alerts and follow incident procedures.
Responsibilities:
Monitoring – Review alerts and logs from SIEM and security tools and identify suspicious activity.
Incident Support – Assist in triage, record incident details, and follow the escalation playbook.
Vulnerability Management – Help run scans, list findings, and track fixes with the relevant teams.
Security Awareness – Support secure configuration checks and basic web security reviews using OWASP Top 10.
Documentation – Maintain clear reports on alerts, incidents and security checks performed.
Job Requirements:
•
B.E./B.Tech/BCA/MCA (or final-year student) in Computer Science, IT, Cybersecurity or a related field
Understanding of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP), operating systems and basic cryptography
Knowledge of common threats such as phishing, SQL injection and XSS
Security virtual internships, labs or certifications (e.g., Security+, CEH foundations) are a plus
Analytical mindset and attention to detail
Willingness to work in shifts if required

title: Machine Learning Engineer
context:
Machine Learning Engineer
Primary Job Responsibilities:
The Machine Learning Engineer is an entry-level role for graduates who have built ML projects and want to grow into applied machine learning. The candidate will work with data scientists and engineers on real datasets and models.
Responsibilities:
Data Preparation – Clean, transform and split datasets, and create features using Python and pandas.
Model Building – Train and evaluate baseline models with scikit-learn and report metrics such as accuracy, precision and recall.
Experimentation – Track experiments in notebooks, compare results, and document what worked and what did not.
Deployment Support – Help wrap trained models into simple APIs using FastAPI.
Learning – Read papers and documentation, and share findings in team knowledge sessions.
Job Requirements:
•
B.E./B.Tech/M.Sc/MCA (or final-year student) in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science or a related field
Strong Python with NumPy, pandas and scikit-learn
Understanding of core ML concepts: regression, classification, overfitting, cross-validation
Basic statistics and linear algebra
Projects or Kaggle work that show end-to-end problem solving are a plus
Curiosity and clear communication of results

title: Full Stack Developer
context:
Full Stack Developer
Primary Job Responsibilities:
The Full Stack Developer is an entry-level role for graduates comfortable with both frontend and backend basics. The candidate will build features end to end, from the database and API to the user interface, with senior guidance.
Responsibilities:
Frontend – Build React components and pages that consume backend APIs.
Backend – Develop simple REST endpoints using FastAPI, Node.js or Spring Boot, with input validation.

Quality – Write basic tests, fix bugs found in QA, and follow code-review feedback.
Delivery – Use Git, deploy to staging, and update task status and documentation during sprints.

•
B.E./B.Tech/BCA/MCA (or final-year student) in Computer Science, IT or a related field
Working knowledge of JavaScript and React
Basic backend skills in Python, Java or Node.js
Understanding of SQL, REST APIs and Git
Good grasp of data structures and algorithms
At least one full-stack project on GitHub is a plus

title: Database Engineer
context:
Database Engineer
Primary Job Responsibilities:
The Database Engineer is an entry-level role for graduates who enjoy working with data models, queries and pipelines. The candidate will support the data team in maintaining reliable databases and simple ETL jobs.
Responsibilities:
Query Development – Write and optimize SQL queries, views and stored procedures for reporting and applications.
ETL Support – Help build and monitor simple pipelines that load CSV, JSON and XML files into database tables.
Data Validation – Check loaded data for accuracy, duplicates and missing values, and report issues.
Maintenance – Assist with backups, indexing and routine housekeeping under senior supervision.
Documentation – Keep table definitions, data flows and change notes up to date.
Job Requirements:
•
B.E./B.Tech/BCA/MCA (or final-year student) in Computer Science, IT or a related field
Strong SQL fundamentals: joins, aggregations, subqueries, indexes
Understanding of relational data modeling and normalization
Basic Python or scripting for data loading
Exposure to PostgreSQL, MySQL, or Snowflake is a plus
Accuracy, patience and a structured approach to problem solving
